'''Saj bread''' (Arabic: خبز الصاج) is a thin, unleavened flatbread baked on a griddle known as a ''saj''.

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[cookbook:flour|flour]]
* 250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[cookbook:water|water]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
# Mix flour and water, adding water gradually, until left with a workable [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] thoroughly.
# Cover the dough and let rest for about 5 minutes. Add salt.
# Separate from dough smaller portions and make into balls. Using a flat surface lined with flour, begin to [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll out]] each ball into a flat piece of dough.
# Place flattened dough on [[Cookbook:Griddle|griddle]] and bake until tender. On a heated griddle, cooking only takes a few seconds. Flip-over and cook the other side for only a few seconds.
# Remove from griddle and allow to cool. Fold and store.
